title: tpu-code-stack Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-code-stack agent, the only agent that runs git on plugin code. One action on the campaign repo: the pinned image's vllm_torchtpu history as `base`, branch `stack`, a branch per hypothesis. Each action owes its own fields (the `oneOf`); which caller may take it is the agent's to enforce, and a write action from another caller returns `refused`.

oneOf.description: init: probe the image, tag base, branch stack
branch: a hypothesis branch and its worktree
commit: the plugin changes in a worktree
discard: tag a lost test or a given-up hypothesis
win: cherry-pick a branch onto stack
stack: a branch from base with branches cherry-picked
ref: a ref as a plugin record
show: log, diff and tags of a ref

action.description: init, branch, discard, win, stack and push are hill-climb's; commit is a writer's; ref and show are read-only, show for the reviewer and hill-climb, ref for any caller.

caller.description: Who asks: hill-climb (tpu-agent), a writer (tpu-pallas, a code arm), or the reviewer (tpu-critical-review).

repo.description: The campaign repo, e.g. `./.work/<MODEL_DIR>/hill-climb/<job-id>/plugin`, which init creates; or a copy of the pinned image's plugin tree on this host, e.g. `/workspace/vllm-torchtpu`, which init uses in place.

image.description: init: the pinned image, by digest.

profile.description: init: the compute profile the probe job runs on; unused for a host copy.

name.description: branch, discard, win: the hypothesis branch `hyp/<rank>-<slug>`. stack: the new branch. push: the image name.

from.description: branch: the commit to branch from. Default `stack`.

worktree.description: commit: the worktree whose plugin changes are committed.

message.description: commit: the commit message: the lever and the job ids that measured it. Written to a file and committed with `git commit -F`, never interpolated into a command.

what.description: discard: `test` tags the branch head `tried/<slug>/<n>` and resets it one commit; `hypothesis` tags it `discarded/<slug>` and removes the branch and its worktree.

branches.description: stack: the branches cherry-picked onto base, in order.

ref.description: ref, show: the branch, tag or commit.

against.description: show: the commit the diff is taken from. Default `base`.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace; the probe job's slot is booked in it.
